name: OC-DFG Viewer
author: István Koren
description: An interactive Object-Centric DFG renderer using React Flow and the same tuned ELK layered preset as the OCPN React Flow view. Object types are shown as colored parallel flows and can be toggled in the in-canvas legend.

direction.title: Flow direction
direction.description: Which way the process runs across the canvas. Left to right is the usual reading order; top to bottom suits a long chain of activities in a tall panel.

combineParallelArcs.title: Combine parallel arcs
combineParallelArcs.description: Draw one arc per activity pair, with a color stripe per object type, instead of a separate overlapping arc for each object type.

authors.name: István Koren
authors.affiliation: ELTE University Budapest, Data Science and Engineering
